## Enterprise New Features

### KVCache (LLM inference KV-cache tiering — newest big subsystem)
* LMCache-facing KV cache service; blog post went live recently
* Remote-mounted entries in cache lifecycle, path-based cleanup of non-hot entries in retired volumes
* File path stored in first chunk for direct promotion lookup
* Per-collection write concurrency config, bounded cleanup memory
* CLI/probes moved into seaweedkv-tools

### Table endpoints + tiering (S3-integrated analytical catalogs)
* S3 Tables, Iceberg, and Lance catalog endpoints; unified auth across all three
* Lance catalog Bearer/x-api-key auth
* Automatic table cache admission (bounded), Lance metadata-range caching
* Table placement reconciliation, Snowflake s3compat + OLake Iceberg integration tests

### Remote tiering (volume → S3/remote)
* Configurable multipart upload/download concurrency
* Typed tier errors (missing remote object → NotFound), S3 object write lock for migrations
* One long-lived tokio runtime for blocking tiered reads (Rust)
